subject: Seasonal Buoy Program - Maritimes
text:
Seasonal Buoy Program - Maritimes
Replacement and re-establishment of fixed and floating aids has commenced in the Atlantic South region, in the following areas:
New Brunswick Coast, including the Bay of Fundy and St. John River, Nova Scotia Coast, including Cape Breton Island and Bras D'Or Lakes, Prince Edward Island Coast, Gulf of St. Lawrence and the Northumberland Strait, to the Quebec border.
Buoy replacement and aid re-establishment should be considered on-going and incomplete in all areas until cancellation of this Navigational Warning.
